verdicts.reason: A is close to unusable. The RSVP CTA has shrunk to a tiny pill at the bottom, the Solstice logo and the drink can are microscopic, the three badges are scattered across the canvas, the partner placeholder sits at the far left, 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' has dropped below the body copy, and the tagline is wedged between the date and the time. B at least gives the banner a left-to-right structure: a large can on the left and the text block on the right. But the RSVP button is crammed into a 2x2 grid with the badges at the top right, so it reads as just another badge. 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' has slid to the bottom of the text stack, the right-hand text block is ragged and runs against the edge, and the lower half is mostly dead space apart from a large missing-asset placeholder.
